tei:div.tei:p: lnga pa gtor ma la brten pa'i blo sbyong bgyi ba/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du gtor ma la brten pa'i blo sbyang bya snyam du bsams nas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'di rin po che yangs shing rgya che ba gcig tu bsgom/ rang gi lus dum bur gtubs la snod khengs par bsgom nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir gyur par bsgom/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la sogs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod byas pas/ dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma dpal mgon dang / lha mo la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba zhal gyis bzhes pa dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams kyis bskor nas gsol bar bsams la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ke te saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas sangs kyis gsol bar bsam/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs par gyur cig /ces brjod/ bdag gi bsod nams stobs dang ni/ /zhes pa'i tshig brjod/ de ltar lus ni drangs nas med/ sems la ni rang bzhin med pas rang bzhin med pa'i ngang la lhan gyis gzhag /de nas ldang bar 'dod na/ dge ba bsngo/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ gtor ma la brten pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// ༈ /drug pa 'byung ba la brten pa'i blo sbyong bgyi ba/ spyod 'jug las/ sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang / /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang / /sems can dpag tu med pa yi/ /rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i rgyur yang shog /ces gsungs pas/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'byung ba la brten pa'i blo sbyong bsgom snyam du bsam nas/ rang gi lus po 'di'i sha dang rus pa rnams phyi'i 'byung ba sa la thim par bsgom/ khrag dang chu ser rnams chu la thim par bsgom/ dbugs rnams rlung la thim par bsgom/

drod rnams me la thim par bsgom/ lus 'byung ba bzhir gyur pa 'di sas sra zhing brtan pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed/ chus brlan zhing gsher ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed/ mes tsha zhing bsreg pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed/ rlung gis yang zhing g.yo ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed/ nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis mig gnyis su byas nas sems can gyi don byed pa yin te/ sems can zas za ba rnams rang gi sha za bar bsgom/ gos gyon pa rnams rang gi pags pa gyon par bsgom/ skom 'thung ba rnams rang gi khrag 'thung bar bsgom/ de nas sems can rnams kyi sdig sdug rang la smin par bsgom/ rang gi bde dge thams cad sems can la smin par bsgom/ de gnyis phar log tshur log tu bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang blos blangs nas sems can la smin par bsgom/ de ltar sems can rnams sdig sdug dang bral/ byang chub tu sems bskyed nas tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis dag nas sangs rgyas par bsgom/ 'byung ba bzhi'i lus la oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun brjod pas bdud rtsir gyur par bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas kyang khengs par bsgom/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang / byang sgra mi snyan dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bdud rtsi dang bcud du gyur pa thams cad kyis kyang khengs par bsgom/ de dang por bla ma dang yi dam la dbul/ de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la dbul/ de nas rigs drug gi sems can rnams la phul bas de rnams kyis bdud rtsi rnams ma lus par sangs kyis gsol bar bsam/ de rnams kyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku thob par bsgom/ de ltar lus ni bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ rigs drug rnams la phul nas med/

sems ni rang bzhin gyis grub pa med pa'i ngang la lhan gyis 'jog pa yin gsungs/ yi dam gyi bsgom bzlas sngar bzhin bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ 'byung ba la brten pa'i blo sbyong gi le'u ste drug pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 gtor ma brten pa'i blo sbyong dang / 'byung ba la brten pa'i blo sbyong / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
